subject: a floating plain doorway over grass

composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Paint a plain wooden doorway floating slightly above a quiet meadow, positioned below center. Inside the empty frame, the air is only a little warmer and brighter than the surrounding landscape. Fine grasses bend beneath it and cast soft shadows. Keep the wood natural and unmarked, using diffuse morning light and open pale atmosphere rather than magical effects or ominous symbolism. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
